objective: Connect Nike's empowerment positioning with athletes challenging the status quo.
businessContext: The campaign used a prominent and polarizing athlete-led cultural position.
strategy: Accept polarization to dramatize a long-running belief in athletic aspiration and social challenge.
outcomes: Nike described the campaign as a global conversation catalyst that connected deeply with consumers.
whatWorked: The position was connected to an established brand belief and athlete relationships.
whatFailed: First-party narrative does not establish incremental commercial effect or quantify polarization costs.
transferConditions: The position is consistent with established brand behavior and leadership accepts stakeholder polarization.
nonTransferConditions: Do not borrow controversy when the brand lacks credible history, affected-community relationships or risk tolerance.

sources.title: Nike FY18 Summary Report
sources.methodology: First-party qualitative description; no isolated campaign incrementality.
